evidence: the-primary-interface-keeps-working: network_dhcp.pp:4-7 warns that once puppet manages one interface it must manage all of them, i.e. the risk to the interfaces the class does not manage; the effect checks p8test0 up via ifupdown while the route to 1.1.1.1 still leaves via enp0s3 (netplan) and answers, which tests exactly that risk. The action is a no-op (true), declared mutating only for ordering after the restart; its effect pings 1.1.1.1 (outside the node), declared in mutates and read-only for the node

a-restart-of-networking-keeps-the-address: network_dhcp.pp:12 network_config onboot=>'true', method=>'dhcp' writes an auto/inet dhcp stanza, which the networking service (ifupdown, local change #10) brings up on restart; the effect requires networking active and a 10.251.0.100-150 lease on p8test0 (reviewer run: 'active', '10.251.0.N/24')

the-interface-stanza-says-dhcp-at-boot: network_dhcp.pp:12 (onboot true -> 'auto p8test0', family inet + method dhcp -> 'iface p8test0 inet dhcp', hotplug false -> no allow-hotplug) and :11 package ifupdown-extra installed; probe greps exactly those two stanza lines and dpkg status, expect matches what the code produces under the p8test0 fixture
